text:
Mari: Quick design review — we need a call on dense vs compact layout for the usage/billing view. Figma here: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/usage-grid (proto). TL;DR: dense shows token breakdown inline in each card; compact turns details into expandable rows. Which direction for org vs project?
Sam: I lean compact for project pages — less vertical noise, faster scan.
Jia: Compact is nice, but org admins want at-a-glance totals. Hybrid? Dense for org, compact for project.
Omar: Agree with Jia. Also dense should include a small sparkline + delta so org owners see trends without expanding.
Maya: Also a UX ask: move the invoice download CTA from the bottom right into the period selector area. Customers keep missing it.
Priya: Accessibility nits: the red token highlight doesn't meet AA at 12px, and expandable rows aren't keyboard-focusable in current mock.
Mari: Good catch Priya — we can bump font or swap the hue. Also add visible focus ring for row toggles.
Sam: Proposal: show mini-sparkline + % delta top-right on dense cards, keep compact rows with a chevron. Add a per-user toggle (Compact/Dense).
Jia: Per-user toggle is good. Default: Org pages = Dense, Project pages = Compact. Remember preference per user.
Alex: From infra: virtualization will be needed if dense loads many mini-charts. We can lazy-load chart SVGs and paginate server-side totals to avoid double-counting.
Omar: On staging the expand animation lagged when many rows open — likely we need virtualization + request batching for token breakdown queries.
Priya: VoiceOver: expandable rows currently announce only 'button'. Should announce like: 'Expand project details, 3 line items, total $X'. Also ensure heading order is logical.
Mari: Checklist I added to the Figma notes and acceptance criteria: contrast fix, keyboard nav and focus, VO announcements, sticky user pref, invoice CTA relocate, virtualization for dense view. I'll make a small PR for the copy.
Sam: Copy nits: change 'Total tokens' -> 'Tokens used', and 'Cost (USD)' -> 'Estimated cost (USD)'. Also adjust the tooltip copy for token breakdown to be less technical.
Maya: OK — @Sam please push the copy PR and I'll schedule a 20min sync tomorrow to sign off.
Sam: On it :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: New prototype build deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.dev/usage-grid-v2 — please validate in Chrome, Firefox, VoiceOver and NVDA.
Omar: Tested staging quick pass — focus order still off when using keyboard to jump between charts. Leaving detailed notes in the Figma comments. :eyes:
Priya: I'll run the a11y checklist tomorrow AM and list required ARIA labels for the expand buttons.
Mari: Thanks all — will update Figma and add a short demo clip for the sync.
